description: Animated Windows notch and dock with media controls, widgets, quick settings, system tray integration, and taskbar replacement.
notes: Uses the publisher's portable ZIP, which contains only nectar.exe at the archive root; the NSIS/setup installer is not run.
Nectar's optional Dock can hide the native Windows taskbar while enabled. Turn Dock off or exit Nectar normally to restore the native taskbar. The application's own updater is left unchanged.
